title: Human Decision
description: An attributable human decision that authorizes a consequential state change. Must always name a human; a decision cannot be attributed to a model or to 'the system'.

decided_by_role.description: The human role that made the decision. Never null.

basis_refs.description: References to evidence, claims, or a proposed_action considered in making the decision.

proposed_action_id.description: Set when this decision approves or rejects a specific proposed model action.
